normalized.description: The Mhlanga lab, as of September 2020 to be the Department of Cell Biology at the Radboud Institute for Molecular Life Sciences, has the need to further improve and increase its quantitative and qualitative capabilities for spatial transcriptomics and proteomics. To achieve this, we intend to purchase an Optical Biosystems StellarVision, a High Resolution proprietary Synthetic Aperture Optics (SAO) based technology that is the only product in the market that offers the resolution similar to 100x oil immersion lens simultaneously with the large Field of View (FOV), large Depth of Field (DOF), and long Working Distance (WD) of 20x/0.45NA dry high lens. Imaging data can be collected, processed, and analysed to quantify individual RNA molecules across 100,000+ single cells in 0.3 - 0.5 cm2 tissue sections. Optical Biosystems has demonstrated a robust and automated method for detecting 30 gene targets via smRNA FISH with sub-cellular resolution across large tissue sections. Unlike previous methods, these technology improvements ensure that researchers do not have to choose between speed or resolution when conducting experiments in spatial genomics. Следгаранционната поддръжка на софтуера на системи за управление на въздушното движение – ATM обхваща системи за обработка на радарна информация и полетни планове (Air Traffic Management – ATM, Radar Data Processing System – RDPS/FDPS, Central&work station и визуализирането на радарна информация във формата на ASTERIX Cat.62) от състава на КИНС на летищата на ВВС Граф Игнатиево, Крумово, Безмер и изнесено работно място във военно формирование 28540 – Труд по приложен списък – Приложение № 1 към ТС С 93.3975.22.
